title: International Clothing Size Converter & Chart
metaDescription: Comprehensive global apparel conversion chart comparing US, UK, European, French, Italian, and Japanese sizing standards.
directAnswer: International clothing sizing varies significantly across regional fashion markets. A US women's size 6 translates to a UK 10, French EU 38, Italian 42, and Japanese size 9. When purchasing overseas garments, using anatomical body circumference in centimeters provides the most reliable fit across differing international grading rules.

faq.question: What is a US Women's size Small (S) internationally?
faq.answer: US Small (sizes 4-6) corresponds to UK 8-10, EU 36-38, Italian 40-42, and Japanese sizes 7-9.

faq.question: Why do Italian clothing sizes look so large numerically?
faq.answer: Italian sizing is based on half the total chest/bust circumference in centimeters, leading to labels like 40, 42, 44, and 46.

faq.question: What is the best way to avoid sizing errors when ordering clothes abroad?
faq.answer: Always consult the brand's metric centimeter chart for bust, waist, and hip measurements rather than relying solely on regional numeric tags.
